basis: brief, six boards, and all 21 individual blind screenshots viewed at original resolution
ranking_semantics: best-first groups; same group indicates tie

product-new.main_tradeoff: A is calmer; C's serif deck adds warmth but competes with the workspace hierarchy.

product-refine.main_tradeoff: Modest improvements to title/deck rhythm; A and C have no reliably decisive aesthetic difference.

editorial-new.main_tradeoff: B balances display and reading best; A strands day. and city. on final lines.

editorial-refine.main_tradeoff: A improves page silhouette with a phrase-preserving title break but is a larger intervention and weakens the aside's phrase break.

native-new.main_tradeoff: C gives quiet title scale and phrasing; B is more dominant but avoids A/C's isolated notice. ending.

native-refine.main_tradeoff: A improves headline phrasing and spacing; all retain the one-word city. paragraph ending.

secondary_check.scope: supplied screenshots only; no OCR, accessibility, interaction, or alternate-viewport testing
